title: Button
description: An interactive button that can link to other pages or trigger actions. Use buttons for call-to-action elements like "Add to Cart", "Learn More", or "Contact Us".

label.title: Text
label.description: The text displayed on the button.

link.title: URL
link.description: The destination link when the button is clicked. Supports internal pages or external URLs.

variant.title: Style
variant.description: Visual appearance of the button. Defaults to Primary.
